selection.target_episode_rule: highest available episode id selected from metadata and carrier identities before target tactile loading
selection.source_episode_rule: all other carrier-complete episodes of the same physical object

model.robot_tactile_alignment: monotone common-endpoint resampling because the mounted legacy robot arrays and raw tactile arrays expose no shared released timestamp carrier
model.tactile_preprocessing: subtract matched released median, positive clamp, keep the twelve URDF taxel rows, clear column 31, 2x2 spatial pooling, source-only feature scaling

uncertainty.calibration: leave-one-source-episode-out residuals with donor-only mean correction and a source-fitted scalar covariance multiplier

statistics.relation_breaking_control: permute target future-action features while preserving tactile prefixes and model parameters

claim_boundary: Retrospective same-object cross-action tactile-response development evidence. A positive result motivates a separately frozen reserved-object or 3-D geometry confirmation; it is not itself an ICRA paper claim, strict counterfactual validation, dense 4-D geometry validation, or state-of-the-art evidence.
